title: File:White House West Wing - 1st Floor with the Press Briefing Room highlighted.jpg
desc:
A floorplan of the first floor of the West Wing of the White House.  Note that, depending on the administration, some positions (V.P., Chief of Staff, etc.) may be located in different offices than are shown here.  Image is not to scale.

In blue, the James S. Brady Briefing Room.
